gaps.lead: They say the new bridge will cut journey times in half.
gaps.sentence: Journey times ___ in half by the new bridge.
gaps.explanation: X is said to be + participle: journey times are said to be cut.

gaps.lead: I don't usually drink coffee at night.
gaps.explanation: be (not) used to = (not) accustomed to: I'm not used to coffee at night.

gaps.lead: The rescue team managed to reach the village by helicopter.
gaps.sentence: The rescue team ___ reaching the village by helicopter.
gaps.explanation: manage to do = succeed IN doing.

gaps.lead: He is so impatient that he never reads instructions.
gaps.explanation: so impatient that he never reads = too impatient to read.

gaps.lead: 'I may be late tonight,' my wife said.
gaps.sentence: My wife said ___ late that night.
gaps.explanation: may often backshifts to might: she might be late.

gaps.answer: as close to the beach as
gaps.lead: The hotel was further from the beach than we expected.
gaps.explanation: further than expected = not as close as expected.
